# KI-143 — Web: local entry and build

**Lane:** web · **Complexity:** 2 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KI-140, KI-141, KI-142, KI-144 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `7672b0e5` (first researched at `5ad41c8b`; see reconciliation.md R-REFRESH)

## Outcome

`pnpm --filter @khala/web build:local` creates `apps/web/dist-local/`. It holds `index.html`, `assets/*.js`, `assets/*.css` and the three `.woff2` brand fonts. The helper (KI-131/KI-137) serves that folder on `http://127.0.0.1:47830`. Opening `/` lands on `/conversations` and runs the same Khala screens as khala.aiur.team. Behind them are the local ports from KI-140..KI-142, with no sign-in and no Log out (KI-144).

The bundle never contains `matrix-js-sdk`, the Rust crypto WASM, the hosted control API client, Google Fonts, `/api/human/` or `khala.aiur.team`. The build fails if it does, and a test in `pnpm test:browser` proves this on every PR.

The hosted build (`pnpm build`, Netlify) is unchanged.

## Context and evidence

- **D4** says the human UI is the full web app, run against a local adapter, with no copied screens. **P4** says the local web app is a second Vite build, `build:local` → `dist-local/`. **AE5** and **AE10** cover "the browser bundle opens zero non-loopback connections; nothing contacts khala.aiur.team, Google or a Matrix homeserver". **KTD6** and **KTD9** say the local web bundle is checked for no hosted origins.
- `research/web-seam.md` §1, §5.4, §5.5 and §6:
  - only `apps/web/src/main.tsx` imports Matrix (`:7`) and the hosted control API (`:4`);
  - every screen reads only `HumanApplicationPorts` (`apps/web/src/composition/human/application.ts:33-59`).
  - So a **second entry** that builds the same ports bundle from `composition/local/*` gives zero hosted change and a Matrix-free bundle. A runtime flag in `main.tsx` would still ship the Matrix chunks.
- This ticket is the web composition point (plan integration ledger: "Web local ports (KI-140..142) ↔ helper routes (KI-133..135): KI-143 composes"). It writes no port logic of its own. The listening-mode and roster functions that L13's `ports.ts` comment mentions are implemented by KI-142's `createLocalMembers` (pinned in KI-142); this ticket only wires them.

## Scope

1. `apps/web/src/composition/local/ports.ts`:
   - `createLocalHumanPorts` (pinned, L13), which composes the KI-140/141/142 modules into `HumanApplicationPorts & { dispose(): void }`;
   - `localInitialPath`.
2. `apps/web/src/local-main.tsx`: the local composition root. It mirrors `apps/web/src/main.tsx:28-90`, minus the hosted config gate, the tab handoff, Matrix and `/api/human`.
3. `apps/web/local.html`: `apps/web/index.html` without the Google Fonts links.
4. `apps/web/vite.local.config.mjs`:
   - outputs `dist-local/index.html` through a rename plugin;
   - has a bundle-guard plugin that fails the build on a forbidden module or a `.wasm` asset.
5. `"build:local"` in `apps/web/package.json`.
6. Ignore `dist-local` in `.gitignore`, ESLint and the boundary checker.
7. Tests:
   - `ports.test.ts` (vitest, fake `fetch`);
   - `local-bundle.browser.spec.ts` (node:test under `test:browser`): it builds the real local entry and scans it, plus a mutation check.

- Serving `dist-local/`, the CSP header, the owner cookie and the `/open/<token>` redirect: **KI-131** and **KI-137**.
- Install docs that add the `build:local` step: **KI-150**.

```ts
export interface LocalHttp {
  get<T>(path: string, decode: (v: unknown) => Decoded<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<LocalHttpResult<T>>;
  send<T>(method: 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'DELETE', path: string, body: unknown, decode: (v: unknown) => Decoded<T>, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<LocalHttpResult<T>>;   // adds x-khala-local: 1
}
export function createLocalHttp(input: { origin: string; fetch?: typeof fetch; timeoutMs?: number }): LocalHttp;   // same-origin credentials; default timeout 10 s, long-poll callers pass their own signal
```

L11 (what the helper does with this build), verbatim:

> **Static web app:** `GET` of any non-`/api/`, non-`/open/`, non-`/healthz` path serves `apps/web/dist-local/` (env override `KHALA_LOCAL_WEB_DIR`), with SPA fallback to `index.html`; assets get `cache-control: no-cache`. A missing build answers `503 {"error":"web_not_built"}` and the CLI tells the user to run `pnpm --filter @khala/web build:local`.

### Invariants

1. **The bundle is Matrix-free and hosted-free.** No chunk module id matches `FORBIDDEN_LOCAL_MODULE` (below); no `.wasm` asset exists; no JS asset contains `matrix-js-sdk`, `initRustCrypto`, `.wasm`, `/api/human/`, `khala.aiur.team` or `fonts.googleapis.com`. The guard runs in the build itself, so every `build:local` enforces it, not only the test.
2. **The output is `dist-local/index.html`**, never `dist-local/local.html`. The helper's SPA fallback (L11) serves `index.html`.
3. **No public dir.** `apps/web/public/_redirects` is Netlify-only and must not appear in `dist-local/`.
4. **No env.** `local-main.tsx` reads no `import.meta.env`, so it has no `PUBLIC_*` hosted origins.
5. **`/` → `/conversations`** through `history.replaceState` before the application starts. The other paths go through `readHumanEntry` unchanged.
6. **The ports bundle has no `agentJoin` and no `inviteAgent`** (keys absent, not `undefined`), and no `tabHandoff` is passed. `syncStatus` is `conversations.syncStatus`, as hosted wires `matrix.syncStatus`; nothing renders it (`apps/web/src/composition/human/mount.test.tsx:265-273`).
7. **One instance of each.** One `LocalHttp`, one session, one members cache, one conversations index, one substrate and one channel service per page. They are shared by reference:
   - the substrate's `members` is the same object whose methods back `describeParticipant` and `listeningMode`;
   - the channel service's `onObserve` is `conversations.viewing`;
   - the profile port's `onUsername` is `session.noteUsername`.
   - Every method is passed as an arrow wrapper (`(...a) => members.listeningMode(...a)`), so a class-based implementation keeps its `this`.
8. **The hosted build is unchanged:**
   - `pnpm --filter @khala/web build` emits exactly what it did;
   - the hosted `dist/` output gets nothing from this ticket;
   - `build` does **not** call `build:local`.
9. **CI decision:** no new CI step. `local-bundle.browser.spec.ts` runs under the existing "Browser tests" step (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` lines 37-41, `pnpm test:browser`), which builds the local entry once per PR.
   - `pnpm build` (`ci.yml` line 61, and Netlify's `pnpm --filter @khala/web build`, `netlify.toml` line 9) stays hosted-only, so Netlify does no extra work.
   - KI-160 builds `dist-local` itself.

### Worked example

`apps/web/vite.local.config.mjs`. The rename plugin was verified with vite 7.3.6 in a scratch build: `local.html` input → `dist-local/index.html`, with `<script type="module" crossorigin src="/assets/local-<hash>.js">`.

```js
// Builds the local web app that `khala local serve` hosts on 127.0.0.1 into
// dist-local: the hosted screens composed over the loopback helper
// (src/local-main.tsx). No Netlify headers, no public dir, no Google Fonts and
// no Matrix: the bundle guard below fails the build if any reaches it.
import { defineConfig } from 'vite';

// import.meta.dirname, not node:path/url: apps/web may not import node built-ins.
const here = import.meta.dirname;

/** Module ids that must never reach the local bundle (D3, AE10). */
export const FORBIDDEN_LOCAL_MODULE = new RegExp([
  String.raw`[\\/]node_modules[\\/](?:matrix-js-sdk|@matrix-org)[\\/]`,
  String.raw`[\\/]packages[\\/]messaging[\\/]src[\\/]browser-device[\\/]`,
  String.raw`[\\/]src[\\/]composition[\\/]human[\\/](?:matrix-browser|browser-api|hosted-config|tab-handoff)\.tsx?$`,
].join('|'));

/** Fails the build when a forbidden module or any WebAssembly reaches the bundle. */
function localBundleGuard() {
  return {
    name: 'khala-local-bundle-guard',
    apply: 'build',
    generateBundle(_options, bundle) {
      for (const output of Object.values(bundle)) {
        if (output.type === 'asset' && output.fileName.endsWith('.wasm')) this.error(`WebAssembly in the local bundle: ${output.fileName}`);
        if (output.type !== 'chunk') continue;
        for (const id of output.moduleIds) if (FORBIDDEN_LOCAL_MODULE.test(id)) this.error(`forbidden module in the local bundle: ${id}`);
      }
    },
  };
}

/** Vite names the page after its input; the helper serves index.html (contracts L11). */
function localIndexHtml() {
  return {
    name: 'khala-local-index-html',
    apply: 'build',
    enforce: 'post',
    generateBundle(_options, bundle) {
      const page = bundle['local.html'];
      if (!page || page.type !== 'asset') return this.error('local.html is missing from the local bundle');
      delete bundle['local.html'];
      this.emitFile({ type: 'asset', fileName: 'index.html', source: page.source });
    },
  };
}

export default defineConfig({
  root: here,
  base: '/',
  publicDir: false,
  logLevel: 'warn',
  plugins: [localBundleGuard(), localIndexHtml()],
  build: {
    outDir: `${here}/dist-local`,
    emptyOutDir: true,
    rollupOptions: { input: `${here}/local.html` },
  },
});
```

`apps/web/src/composition/local/ports.ts`, the whole composition (imports elided):

```ts
export function localInitialPath(location: EntryLocation): string {
  return location.pathname === '/' ? '/conversations' : readHumanEntry(location).path;
}

export function createLocalHumanPorts(input: { origin: string; limits: ContentLimits; fetch?: typeof fetch }): HumanApplicationPorts & { dispose(): void } {
  const http = createLocalHttp({ origin: input.origin, ...(input.fetch ? { fetch: input.fetch } : {}) });
  const session = createLocalSession(http);
  const members = createLocalMembers(http, input.limits);
  const conversations = createLocalConversations(http);
  const substrate = createLocalSubstrate({ http, limits: input.limits, members, generation: () => session.device.current().generation });
  const channel = createLocalChannelService({
    principal: LOCAL_PRINCIPAL, actor: () => session.participant(), device: session.device, substrate, limits: input.limits,
    onObserve: roomId => conversations.viewing(roomId),
  });
  let disposed = false;
  return {
    identity: session.identity,
    device: session.device,
    participant: () => session.participant(),
    room: channel.room,
    conversations,
    syncStatus: conversations.syncStatus,
    admission: localAdmission,
    channelLinks: createLocalChannelLinks(http),
    profile: createLocalProfilePort(http, { onUsername: username => session.noteUsername(username) }),
    agentNames: createLocalAgentNamesPort(http),
    describeParticipant: participantId => members.describe(participantId),
    describeMatrixUser: userId => members.describeMatrixUser(userId),
    listeningMode: (roomId, userId) => members.listeningMode(roomId, userId),
    subscribeListeningModes: (roomId, listener) => members.subscribeListeningModes(roomId, listener),
    setListeningMode: (roomId, userId, mode, txnId) => members.setListeningMode(roomId, userId, mode, txnId),
    roomParticipants: (roomId, signal) => members.roomParticipants(roomId, signal),
    limits: input.limits,
    dispose() {
      if (disposed) return;
      disposed = true;
      for (const stop of [() => channel.dispose(), () => conversations.dispose(), () => void session.device.stop()]) {
        try { stop(); } catch { /* best effort: one failure must not skip the rest */ }
      }
    },
  };
}
```

### Steps

1. **`ports.ts`.** Write it exactly as the worked example shows.
   - Imports: `EntryLocation` and `readHumanEntry` from `../human/entry`; `HumanApplicationPorts` (type) from `../human/application`; `ContentLimits` (type) from `@khala/contracts/messaging/index`; the upstream factories from `./http`, `./session`, `./profile`, `./agent-names`, `./substrate`, `./channel-service`, `./members`, `./conversations` and `./links`.
   - No other logic. Port behaviour (modes, roster, unread, links) lives in KI-140..KI-142; if a flow is wrong, it is wrong there.
   - TypeScript checks the return against `HumanApplicationPorts` (`exactOptionalPropertyTypes` is on). If a landed upstream type does not fit a key, stop; do not cast.
2. **`local-main.tsx`** follows `apps/web/src/main.tsx:28-90`:
   1. Imports: `decodeContentLimits` from `@khala/contracts/messaging/index`, `createHumanApplication`, `mountKhalaContent`, `renderHumanRoom`, `createHumanRouteCodec`, and `createLocalHumanPorts` + `localInitialPath` from `./composition/local/ports`.
   2. CSS, in this order: `./brand/fonts.css`, `./brand/tokens.css`, `./shell/shell.css`, `./features/create-channel/create-channel.css`, `./features/timeline/timeline.css`, `./features/channel/channel.css`, `./main.css`.
   3. `#app` missing → `throw new Error('missing Khala application mount')`.
   4. Limits as in `main.tsx:29-34` (32 768 / 255 / 255).
   5. `const initialPath = localInitialPath(location)`. If it differs from `${location.pathname}${location.search}`, call `history.replaceState(null, '', initialPath)`.
   6. `ports = createLocalHumanPorts({ origin: location.origin, limits })`; `application = createHumanApplication(ports, { initialPath })`.
   7. `routes = createHumanRouteCodec({ origin: location.origin, basePath: '/', allowInsecureLoopback: true })`.
   8. `mountKhalaContent({ target, application, identity: ports.identity, routes, mode: 'standalone', account: 'local_owner', renderRoom: renderHumanRoom, navigateRoute(path) { history.pushState(null, '', path); application.navigate(path); } })`.
   9. `popstate` → `application.navigate(\`${location.pathname}${location.search}\`)`.
   10. `pagehide` (`{ once: true }`) → remove the listener, then `mounted.dispose()`, `application.dispose()`, `ports.dispose()`.
   11. No `import.meta.env`; no other imports from `composition/human/*`.
3. **`local.html`** and **`vite.local.config.mjs`** exactly as in the worked example.
4. **`package.json`**: `"build:local": "vite build --config vite.local.config.mjs"`, directly after `"build"`. Do not add it to `"build"`.
5. **Ignores**: the `.gitignore`, `eslint.config.mjs` and `scripts/check-boundaries.mjs` one-liners above.
6. **Tests**: see the scenarios below.
7. **Run it.**
   - `pnpm --filter @khala/web build:local`; `find apps/web/dist-local -type f` shows `index.html`, `assets/local-*.js`, `assets/*.css` and three `assets/*.woff2`, and no `local.html` or `_redirects`.
   - Then `pnpm lint` must stay green with `dist-local/` present.

## Test scenarios

`apps/web/src/composition/local/ports.test.ts` (vitest). Origin is `http://127.0.0.1:47830`.
- Mock the two heavy factories so the test checks composition, not their behaviour (which KI-141 tests):
  - `vi.mock('./channel-service', () => ({ createLocalChannelService: vi.fn(input => { captured.channel = input; return fakeChannel; }) }))`, where `fakeChannel = { room: fakeRoom, stop: vi.fn(), dispose: vi.fn() }`;
  - `vi.mock('./substrate', () => ({ createLocalSubstrate: vi.fn(input => { captured.substrate = input; return {} }) }))`.
- Everything else (http, session, members, conversations, links, profile) is real, over a fake `fetch` that records `{ url, method, headers, body }` and answers from a route table, as in `apps/web/src/composition/human/browser-api.test.ts`.
- Conversations start a long-poll on creation; answer `GET /api/local/channels*` with `{ revision: 1, channels: [] }`, and use fake timers so it does not spin.

1. `localInitialPath`:

   | Input `{pathname, search}` | Output |
   |---|---|
   | `{'/', ''}` | `'/conversations'` |
   | `{'/', '?x=1'}` | `'/conversations'` |
   | `{'/new', '?code=1'}` | `'/new'` |
   | `{'/conversations', '?mount=hosted-content'}` | `'/conversations'` |
   | `{'/channels/!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal', ''}` | unchanged |
2. Key set:
   - `'agentJoin' in ports === false` and `'inviteAgent' in ports === false`;
   - `ports.admission === localAdmission`;
   - `ports.room === fakeRoom`;
   - `ports.syncStatus === ports.conversations.syncStatus` (cast to `LocalConversations`);
   - `typeof ports.dispose === 'function'`.
3. Substrate wiring: `captured.substrate.http.origin === 'http://127.0.0.1:47830'`, `captured.substrate.generation() === 1`, and `captured.substrate.members.describe` is a function.
4. Channel-service wiring:
   - `captured.channel.principal === LOCAL_PRINCIPAL` and `captured.channel.device === ports.device`;
   - `captured.channel.actor()` equals `ports.participant()`: both `null` before identity loads; both the owner view after `await ports.identity.current()` with `GET /api/local/profile` → `{"userId":"@khala_owner:local","ownerId":"local-owner","username":"kevin","suggestion":"kevin","color":"teal"}`;
   - `typeof captured.channel.onObserve === 'function'`, and calling it with a room id returns a disposer (a function).
5. Members wiring:
   - `await ports.setListeningMode('!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local', '@agent-a1b2c3d4:local', 'async', 'txn_9')` records exactly one POST to `…/api/local/channels/!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw%3Alocal/mode`, with header `x-khala-local: 1` and body `{"agent":"@agent-a1b2c3d4:local","mode":"async","txnId":"txn_9"}`; given `200 {"eventId":"$q3Zp0bE8yS1m4Vt7nC2aRw"}`, it resolves `'sent'`.
   - `ports.listeningMode(room, '@agent-a1b2c3d4:local') === 'sync'` before any member load.
6. Profile → session wiring:
   - After the identity load in 4, `await ports.profile!.setUsername('kev')` with `200 {"username":"kev"}`;
   - then `ports.participant()?.displayName === 'kev'`. This proves `onUsername` is wired to `noteUsername`.
7. `dispose()`:
   - Calling it twice does not throw; `fakeChannel.dispose` is called exactly once.
   - After it, advancing fake timers by 30 s produces no new `fetch` call (the conversations long-poll is aborted).
   - Mutation note: dropping `onUsername` makes 6 fail; passing `members: {}` to the substrate makes 3 fail.

`apps/web/src/composition/local/local-bundle.browser.spec.ts` (node:test, runs under `test:browser`). Pattern: `apps/web/src/composition/human/device-loss.browser.spec.ts:35-45`. `const CONFIG = join(import.meta.dirname, '../../../vite.local.config.mjs')`. Timeout 180 s. Always `rm` the scratch dirs in `finally`.

8. **The real local build is clean.**
   - Build: `const out = await build({ configFile: CONFIG, build: { outDir: scratch, emptyOutDir: true }, logLevel: 'error' })`.
   - Files:
     - `index.html` exists, and `local.html` and `_redirects` do not;
     - `index.html` contains `src="/assets/` and does not contain `fonts.googleapis.com`;
     - `assets/` has at least one `.woff2` and no `.wasm`.
   - Strings: no `assets/*.js` file contains any of `matrix-js-sdk`, `initRustCrypto`, `.wasm`, `/api/human/`, `khala.aiur.team` or `fonts.googleapis.com`. On failure, report each hit with the file name.
9. **Module ids.**
   - Flatten `out` (an array or a single `RollupOutput`) to its `output` items.
   - No chunk `moduleIds` entry matches `FORBIDDEN_LOCAL_MODULE`, imported from the config.
   - Some chunk includes a module id ending in `/src/local-main.tsx` and one ending in `/src/composition/local/ports.ts`, proving the right entry was built.
10. **Mutation check, the guard bites.**
   - Write into a temp dir:
     - `local.html` with `<script type="module" src="./entry.ts"></script>`;
     - `entry.ts`: `import { contentSecurityPolicy } from '<absolute path of apps/web/src/composition/human/hosted-config.ts>'; console.log(contentSecurityPolicy(null));`.
   - `await assert.rejects(build({ configFile: CONFIG, root: tmp, build: { outDir: join(tmp, 'out'), rollupOptions: { input: join(tmp, 'local.html') } }, logLevel: 'silent' }), /forbidden module in the local bundle/)`.
   - Mutation note: deleting `localBundleGuard()` from `plugins` must make this test fail. Removing `localIndexHtml()` must make scenario 8 fail on `index.html`.

```sh

pnpm --filter @khala/web exec node --conditions=khala-source --import tsx --test src/composition/local/local-bundle.browser.spec.ts
CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium pnpm --filter @khala/web test:browser
```

- `pnpm --filter @khala/web exec vite preview --config vite.local.config.mjs --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4320`, then open `http://127.0.0.1:4320/`.
- The URL becomes `/conversations`.
- With no helper, the app shows KI-144's helper-down panel, not a blank page and not a sign-in redirect.
- Devtools Network shows no request to any other origin.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `build:local` creates `apps/web/dist-local/index.html` and `assets/`. There is no `local.html` and no `_redirects`.
- [ ] The build itself fails on a forbidden module or a `.wasm` asset (mutation scenario 10 passes).
- [ ] The bundle contains none of `matrix-js-sdk`, `initRustCrypto`, `.wasm`, `/api/human/`, `khala.aiur.team` or `fonts.googleapis.com`.
- [ ] `createLocalHumanPorts` matches the pinned signature, with no `agentJoin` or `inviteAgent` keys. Every port comes from KI-140..KI-142, wired once and by reference (scenarios 2–7).
- [ ] `/` canonicalizes to `/conversations`; `local-main.tsx` passes `account: 'local_owner'` and no `tabHandoff`.
- [ ] `main.tsx`, `vite.config.ts`, `index.html`, the `build` script, CI and Netlify are unchanged. `pnpm --filter @khala/web build` output is unchanged.
- [ ] `dist-local/` is ignored by git, ESLint and the boundary checker. `pnpm lint` is green after a local build.
- [ ] Scenarios 1–10 pass in CI (`pnpm test` and `pnpm test:browser`).

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if:
  - KI-140, KI-141 or KI-142 landed names or shapes that differ from L13 or the "Additive names pinned by the sibling tickets" block in a way that is not a strict superset: report the drift, do not alias or cast;
  - KI-144 has not added `account` to `mountKhalaContent`.
- **Stop** if the bundle guard trips on a module the local app genuinely needs, for example a shared screen that imports `browser-api.ts` after a later PR. Report the import chain. Do not weaken `FORBIDDEN_LOCAL_MODULE` or the string list.
- **Stop** if making the string scan pass needs an edit outside this ticket's surfaces, for example a contracts constant containing `/api/human/` that tree-shaking keeps. Name the module and line.
- If Vite renames the HTML differently in the installed version (the bundle key is not `local.html`), print `Object.keys(bundle)` in the error and fix the key. Do not move the input file: L1 and L13 pin `apps/web/local.html`.
- `eslint.config.mjs` and `scripts/check-boundaries.mjs` are also edited by KI-101 (it removes the `apps/internal` ignore and the frozen branch). KI-101 merges long before this ticket. Rebase and make the one-token edits on top.
- In-flight PRs #976, #978 and #986 change files this ticket only imports (`room.tsx`, profile ports). Refresh the pointers at pickup. No edit here depends on them.

## Complexity rationale

2: composition and build plumbing only. One composition module (about 50 lines), a roughly 45-line entry and a 50-line config. It needs one programmatic Vite build test and fake-fetch unit tests. No new port logic, no UI.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
